# v1.2.0 Release Notes — Desktop Remote Control, Auto-Updater, Repository Diffs, Integrated Terminal & Unified Feeds

**`bot-team v1.2.0`** advances the multi-device mission-control runtime (`801e70a..HEAD`, **24 tracked issues** across Desktop Electron, Cloud Web, iPadOS, iOS PWA, Tier-2 `CoreServer`, Tier-3 `AppsDaemon`, `bot-team-services` on Railway, and `bot-team-release`) into a self-updating, full-loop engineering environment. Operators can now switch a native Desktop Electron window directly onto remote Cloud hosts (`#F-490`, `#F-500`), review `@pierre/diffs` split/unified diffs and run an **AI Multi-Commit Copilot** (`#F-502`), open live **Integrated PTY Terminals** (`xterm.js` + `btpty` resize) inside the Artifact Panel (`#F-503`, `#F-492`), update `bot-team.app` in place from GitHub Releases with SHA-256 verification and in-app release notes (`#F-493`), unify **Feeds & Issues** across list and dependency graph (`#F-494`), fold high-volume threads with **Feeds Minimal Mode** (`#F-496`), and clear updates in a dedicated **Inbox Unread** tab (`#F-497`) — all while keeping the 20-file Tier-1 `AgentDaemon` closure 100% untouched (`ADR 0012`, `daemon-boundary` `10/10`, `daemonOutdated === false`).


## Architecture Overview (`v1.2.0`)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Desktop["Desktop Electron (DesktopApiMux · RemoteCloudProxy · Auto-Updater)"]
    Mobile["Cloud Web · iPadOS · iOS PWA (30s Refresh Grace · 25s SSE Ping)"]
    Release["GitHub Releases (latest.json · SHA-256 · Release Notes)"]
    Edge["Railway Cloud Gateway (/d/:deviceId/api/v1/* · Warm SSE)"]
    Core["Tier-2 CoreServer (RepoService · TerminalService · Feeds shortTitle)"]
    Apps["Tier-3 AppsDaemon (Build-Hash Auto-Restart · Proxy SDK)"]
    Daemon["Tier-1 AgentDaemon (Frozen 20-File Runtime Closure)"]

    Release -->|"SHA-256 Bundle Swap"| Desktop
    Desktop <-->|"Loopback Proxy or Local IPC"| Edge
    Mobile <-->|"Self-Healing HTTPS + SSE"| Edge
    Edge <-->|"Authenticated WSS Tunnel"| Core
    Core -->|"Resolved Prompts & Lifecycle"| Daemon
    Core <-->|"Auto-Refreshed /app/* & /api/v1/*"| Apps
```


## 1. Desktop Remote Device Switching, Quiet Remote Icons & Live Workspace Sync (`#F-490`, `#F-500`)

Desktop Electron is no longer tethered only to its local socket — a laptop `bot-team.app` can now drive a remote Mac Studio or Cloud server natively without opening a browser:

- **Loopback `RemoteCloudProxy` & `DesktopApiMux` (`BOT-416`, `BOT-417`, `812f209`, `c460126`)**: introduces owner-only `cloud.remote.session` RPCs and an Electron-side loopback HTTP/SSE proxy so switching devices in the Desktop sidebar transparently multiplexes every RPC, SSE stream, Artifact preview, and Bot App iframe to the selected Cloud host (`cli/test/desktop-remote-device.mjs`).
- **Per-Device Workspace Isolation & Live Mobile-to-Desktop Sync (`BOT-417`, `BOT-434`, `c460126`, `6d33801`)**: scopes workspace lists per device (`cli/test/workspaces-device-scope.mjs`), groups cross-device shared repositories cleanly, and synchronizes workspaces created or removed from Mobile/Web live into Desktop Electron without restart.
- **Quiet Icon-Only Remote Agent Badge (`BOT-427`, `91331a5`)**: replaces verbose remote text pills in the left agent sidebar with a compact monochrome cloud-link icon (`#F-500`) that preserves full agent name legibility.

![Desktop Electron switched live onto a remote Cloud host via DesktopApiMux](./artifact/desktop-device-switch-remote.png)

![Quiet icon-only remote badge in the Desktop sidebar agent list](./artifact/sidebar-remote-agent-icon-only.png)

![Live workspace registration sync between Mobile and Desktop Electron](./artifact/desktop-mobile-workspace-sync.png)


## 2. GitHub Releases Client Auto-Updater & In-App Release Notes (`#F-493`)

Desktop clients now stay current automatically from `AgenticPunk/bot-team-release` with cryptographic verification and editorial transparency:

- **SHA-256 Verified Updater Engine & Idle Swap (`BOT-420`, `01c0834`, `bot-team-release` `edfeee5`)**: polls `latest.json` (enriched with `repo`, `releaseUrl`, and embedded milestone `releaseNotes`), verifies downloaded `bot-team-app-<ver>-darwin-<arch>.zip` archives against SHA-256 digests before atomic bundle swap + rollback safety, and supports optional **Auto-update while idle** when no local turns are active (`cli/test/client-updater.mjs`).
- **Sidebar Update Pill, Settings Controls & Release Notes Drawer (`BOT-421`, `9bdec3e`)**: surfaces a quiet monochrome update action in the sidebar when a newer release lands, dedicated check/download/install controls under **Settings → Updates**, and a formatted in-app Release Notes reader inside the Artifact Panel.

![Sidebar update indicator when a verified GitHub Release is available](./artifact/auto-update-sidebar-button.png)

![Rich in-app Release Notes reader opened inside the Artifact Panel](./artifact/auto-update-release-notes-panel.png)

![Client auto-update controls and idle auto-install toggle in Settings](./artifact/auto-update-settings.png)


## 3. Repository Source Control (`@pierre/diffs`) & AI Multi-Commit Copilot (`#F-502`)

Operators can inspect working-tree diffs, browse commit history, and craft clean atomic commits across Desktop, iPad, and Mobile without leaving `bot-team`:

- **Tier-2 `RepoService` & Safe `repo.*` RPCs (`BOT-428`, `5d1a0f3`)**: adds path-jailed Git status, staged/unstaged/commit diff inspection, file staging/unstaging, branch & stash operations, and an **AI Multi-Commit Copilot** (`repo.aiCommitPlan` / `repo.aiCommitAll`) that clusters dirty files into logical Conventional/Issue-prefixed commits (`cli/test/repo-service.mjs`).
- **`@pierre/diffs` Split/Unified Viewer & Full Cross-Device Wiring (`BOT-429`, `BOT-430`, `78a9fd5`, `ef81ed7`)**: integrates `@pierre/diffs` for crisp syntax-highlighted split and unified diffs on Desktop alongside responsive file-tree drawers and 1-tap AI commit review on iPad and Mobile Bento navigation.

![Repository view on Desktop with @pierre/diffs syntax-highlighted diff inspection](./artifact/repository-desktop-diff.png)

![AI Multi-Commit Copilot grouping modified files into logical atomic commits](./artifact/repository-ai-multicommit.png)

![Responsive Repository and diff viewer on Mobile and iPad](./artifact/repository-mobile-view.png)


## 4. Artifact Panel Integrated PTY Terminal & Scoped Panel Navigation (`#F-503`, `#F-492`)

The right-side Artifact Panel now hosts interactive shell sessions and keeps embedded workspace views strictly isolated from main-window navigation:

- **Opt-In `btpty` Live Resize & Tier-2 `TerminalService` (`BOT-431`, `BOT-432`, `c5f64d6`, `0c1b10c`)**: adds opt-in `BTPTY_RESIZE_FD` (`SIGWINCH` / `TIOCSWINSZ`) live PTY resizing to `cli/native/btpty.c` (preserving the frozen Tier-1 JS closure hash `61f73ad173bf0ba0`) and exposes `terminal.create`/`write`/`resize`/`read`/`kill` RPCs streamed live over local IPC, Web SSE, and Cloud tunnels (`cli/test/terminal-pty.mjs`, `cli/test/terminal-rpc.mjs`).
- **Artifact Panel `xterm.js` Terminal Tab (`BOT-433`, `210a283`)**: embeds multi-tab `xterm.js` + `@xterm/addon-fit` terminals inside the Artifact Panel scoped automatically to the active workspace directory.
- **Scoped Artifact Panel Navigation (`BOT-419`, `448162d`)**: wraps embedded right-panel views in `ScopedRouteContext` so clicking links or switching sub-routes inside an Artifact Panel preview never hijacks the primary left/center workspace route.

![Integrated xterm.js PTY Terminal tab running live inside the Artifact Panel](./artifact/artifact-panel-terminal-tab.png)

![Scoped route isolation inside embedded Artifact Panel workspace views](./artifact/artifact-panel-overview-isolated.png)


## 5. Unified Issues & Feeds View + Dependency Graph (`#F-494`)

Operators can now see how operator Feed requests and engineering Issues connect in one place:

- **Non-Invasive `Feeds` Toggle Across List & Graph (`BOT-422`, `a48a273`)**: adds a quiet `Feeds` filter toggle to the Issues header (`cli/test/issues-feeds-unified.mjs`) that weaves linked and standalone `#F-*` threads into both the structured list and the Cytoscape dependency graph, complete with inline `FeedDetailPanel` inspection without leaving Issues.

![Unified Issues and Feeds list view with inline Feed inspection](./artifact/issues-unified-feeds-list.png)

![Unified Issues and Feeds dependency graph showing Feed-to-Issue lineage](./artifact/issues-unified-feeds-graph.png)


## 6. Feeds Minimal Mode & Fast Helper `shortTitle` (`#F-496`, `#C-510-1`)

Long multi-paragraph Feed timelines can now collapse into a scannable single-line index:

- **`FeedPost.shortTitle` with `0ms` Deterministic Fallback & Fast Helper Backfill (`BOT-423`, `0103f1b`)**: computes an immediate `0ms` clean summary title on post creation, refines it asynchronously via Fast Helper, and lazily backfills existing workspace threads (`cli/test/feeds-short-title.mjs`).
- **Icon-Only Minimal Mode Header Toggle & Fold/Expand Cards (`BOT-424`, `BOT-435`, `d49d94a`, `6dae0aa`)**: adds a clean icon-only density toggle in the Feeds header that folds threads into compact issue-style single-line rows (`#F-id`, `shortTitle`, status dot, comment/issue badges) with instant inline click-to-expand on Desktop and Mobile.

![Feeds Minimal Mode compact single-line rows with inline expansion on Desktop](./artifact/feeds-minimal-desktop.png)

![Feeds Minimal Mode with icon-only header toggle on Mobile](./artifact/feeds-minimal-mobile.png)


## 7. Dedicated Inbox `Unread` Tab & Chronological `All` Stream (`#F-497`)

Magazine Inbox now separates active catch-up from historical browsing without reintroducing manual triage buttons:

- **Dedicated `Unread` Default Tab + Stable `All` Stream (`BOT-425`, `62f1e59`)**: opens on a focused `Unread` tab where items clear automatically as they are read, while keeping `All` as a stable chronological archive stream across Desktop, iPad, and Mobile (`cli/test/inbox-store.mjs`).

![Dedicated Inbox Unread tab and chronological All stream on Desktop](./artifact/inbox-unread-tab-desktop.png)

![Inbox Unread and All tabs on Mobile](./artifact/inbox-unread-tab-mobile.png)


## 8. Zero-Rewrite Remote Legacy Apps, Self-Healing Cloud PWA SSE & Fresh-Mac Boot (`#F-487`, `#F-489`, `#F-491`)

Three foundational reliability upgrades harden daily Cloud, Bot App, and fresh-machine operation:

- **Zero-Rewrite Remote Legacy Bot App Proxy & Auto-Refreshed `AppsDaemon` (`BOT-412`, `1bdf9b5`, `bot-team-services` `1604fdc`)**: proxies non-control-plane `/api/v1/*` requests from legacy Bot Apps through `cloud-gateway` via `Referer` device attribution and automatically restarts `AppsDaemon` whenever its build fingerprint changes on `CoreServer` reload (`cli/test/apps-remote-proxy.mjs`).
- **Cloud `30s` Refresh Grace & Self-Healing iOS PWA SSE (`BOT-413`, `BOT-414`, `BOT-415`, `758fe15`, `bot-team-services` `3fee997`, `52bf421`)**: adds a `30s` refresh-token rotation grace window for concurrent iOS PWA tabs/requests, `25s` `event: ping` SSE heartbeats, proactive pre-SSE token refresh, and a wake watchdog that eliminates forced re-logins after phone sleep (`cli/test/cloud-session-resilience.mjs`).
- **Fresh-Mac Core Boot Resilience (`BOT-418`, `4fa688c`)**: expands Node binary discovery across Homebrew/nvm/fnm/Volta/asdf/mise paths, falls back automatically to Electron's bundled runtime (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`) on clean Macs without system Node, and surfaces structured boot diagnostics (`cli/test/fresh-mac-core-boot.mjs`).

![Legacy Bot App running remotely over Cloud Gateway with zero app-code rewrite](./artifact/remote-legacy-app-fixed.png)

![Self-healing Cloud session persistence and SSE stream verified on Mobile PWA](./artifact/mobile-pwa-session-sse-verified.png)
